authority.acceptance_boundary: PPS-1A is an internal checkpoint only; canonical PPS-1 requires accepted PPS-1A and serial PPS-1B

objective: Parse the bounded direct-mapping Agent Skill block-scalar subset and safely rebase a unique root or nested SKILL.md bundle while preserving recursive list parsing, URL safety and owner isolation.

correction_budget.correction: Define rebased directory depth exactly and add the four-versus-five-level tests-first boundary.
correction_budget.on_repeat: release terminal and require materially fresh Root/Sol architecture

parser_and_emitter_contract: Keep _parse_scalar, _split_top_level, _emit_scalar and every block-list and inline-list dispatch unchanged.
Only direct mapping values may enter the new block-header or canonical-JSON dispatch. Recursive list values beginning | or >, including |+ and >-, retain their exact clean-origin strings.

For a non-block direct mapping value that is a double-quoted canonical JSON string, json.loads may replace legacy parsing only when it yields an exact built-in string and json.dumps(decoded) exactly equals the trimmed source token. Invalid or noncanonical quoted tokens retain _parse_scalar behavior. This intentional direct-scalar compatibility takeover is required to reverse the existing _emit_scalar representation and round-trip arbitrary emitted multiline strings; it never applies inside lists.

At direct mapping dispatch, an unquoted value whose first non-space character is | or > is a block-header candidate. Exactly |, |-, > and >- are accepted. Unsupported direct candidates such as |+, >2, comments or duplicated markers raise bounded content-free ValueError; quoted markers remain ordinary strings.

Block content uses spaces only. The first nonblank content line establishes positive indentation; later nonblank lines must have at least that indentation and preserve any extra spaces. A tab or positive under-indentation is malformed. A column-zero key or comment terminates and is reprocessed; another column-zero nonblank line is malformed. Blank lines do not establish indentation; an empty or all-blank block yields an empty string.

Literal style preserves logical boundaries. Folded style replaces a boundary with one space only when both adjacent lines are nonblank and normally indented; blank boundaries and boundaries touching a more-indented line remain newlines. Clip adds exactly one terminal newline to nonempty content; strip adds none; trailing blank logical lines are removed before chomping.

Do not emit block syntax. Existing _emit_scalar JSON output stays byte-for-byte unchanged. Direct canonical JSON decoding supplies exact round-trip for changing-indentation multiline strings while noncanonical direct quoted escapes and all recursive quoted escapes remain legacy.
bundle_contract: Implement the publication-plan validation inside SkillsManager.import_bundle_from_files without changing skill_importer.py. Require type(files) is dict and exact built-in str keys and values.

Before destination-specific mkdir or write, enforce existing MAX_FILES, MAX_FILE_BYTES, MAX_TOTAL_BYTES and text allowlist. After stripping the exact selected source root, define directory_depth as the number of parent components in the rebased destination path: accept directory_depth <= 4 and reject directory_depth > 4. The selected source-root components and final filename do not count. Reject empty, absolute, drive/colon, backslash, control, whitespace-altered, empty, dot and dot-dot path components instead of normalizing them.
Select exactly one path whose final component casefolds exactly to SKILL.md. Root SKILL.md has a valid zero-component source root. Missing, suffix-only and ambiguous candidates fail closed.

Preserve selected parent components exactly and require every entry to be the selected file or an exact-case descendant of that parent. Reject ancestors, siblings and case-mismatched pseudo-descendants. Strip the exact parent prefix so nested/SKILL.md becomes SKILL.md and nested/references/x.md becomes references/x.md.

Reject casefold-equivalent destination collisions and file/directory prefix collisions. Parse selected content, build canonical SKILL.md and every output in memory, and recheck budgets before destination mutation. Selection, path, parse and plan failures raise bounded content-free SkillImportError and leave no destination residue.

Use the parsed skill name or skill as the root-level fallback; never index a missing parent component. Choose a destination absent from loaded names and os.path.lexists. The selected raw SKILL.md is replaced once by canonical output rather than written then overwritten.

Force source imported, status draft and the supplied caller owner. References remain owner-scoped. Allowed text scripts may be stored but are never imported as code, invoked or executed. URL, redirect, fetch, file, depth and byte safety in skill_importer.py remain intact.

tests_first.rule: Materialize and run every named RED node before either source edit; compatibility nodes must already be green and remain green.
tests_first.red_shape: Block, direct canonical JSON and bundle-plan nodes fail behaviorally at clean origin. The list-marker and noncanonical recursive-escape compatibility nodes pass before and after source edits.

stop_rules: Stop before writer dispatch on authority, baseline, pin, path, claim, lease, named-node or architecture-review drift.

Stop implementation on any _parse_scalar, _split_top_level, _emit_scalar, list-dispatch, skill_importer.py or test_skill_importer.py edit; JSON decoding outside direct mapping values; destination mutation before full planning; hostile-path normalization; sibling retention; script execution; existing-destination overwrite; fifth writer path; test weakening; external action; or canonical PPS-1 completion claim.
One bounded correction class maximum; any same-class recurrence after correction releases the candidate and restores exact clean origin before a fresh architecture.
